summary.text: Chris Kapenga is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Senate who has represented District 33 since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served as Senate President from 2021 to 2024 and is a certified public accountant.

paragraphs.text: Chris Kapenga earned a B.S. in accountancy from Calvin College in 1994 and is a CPA.
Before assuming office, he was the owner and president of Integrated Time Systems.
Kapenga served in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing District 99, from 2011 until August 6, 2015.
He was first elected to the Senate in a special election on July 21, 2015, and was sworn in on August 6, 2015.

In the 2023-2024 session he was vice chairman of the Senate Organization Committee and co-chair of the Joint Legislative Council, Employment Relations and Legislative Organization committees; in 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Joint Legislative Audit Committee.
